set.body:
Acceptance criteria
- Bool readable arrays expose all, any, and countTrue for the whole array and for validated Axes with coherent keepDims behavior.
- Empty-domain identities are explicit: all is true, any is false, and countTrue is zero.
- Multi-axis forms plan the reduction once and never create sequential intermediate arrays.
- Owned, borrowed, and mutable sources are accepted without erasing ownership; every array-valued result is owned.
- Primitive Boolean storage is traversed without per-element boxing or generic numeric dispatch, and countTrue cannot overflow the portable Int element limit.
- JVM and Scala.js tests cover rank zero through six, empty and singleton axes, broadcast zero strides, slices, reversals, negative axes, and invalid dtype use.
- Allocation evidence covers scalar and array-valued forms promised for core 1.0.
set.title: Add foundational Boolean reductions to core
